actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity with strong FDR-significant pathway enrichment (coagulation, EMT up; metabolic/secretory down) and large effect sizes. WXS and CNV show only nominal trends, but the transcriptional signal is coherent and not contradicted. Per-set technical confounders are not significant, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0002 has coherent biological support from RNA (immune downregulation, heme metabolism up) and CNV (consistent chromosomal losses) with FDR significance. WXS shows only a nominal BAP1 depletion, but the multi-modal signal is coherent. Per-set technical confounders are not significant, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0002 is better supported than Drop.

C0003 lacks any significant biological enrichment across RNA, WXS, and CNV, with all q-values near 1.0, indicating no coherent molecular identity. The set is strongly confounded by CT manufacturer and scanner model (FDR-significant per-set associations), and its structural cohesion is driven almost entirely by CT features, suggesting the identity is plausibly dominated by technical factors. No supported structural correction or resolvable evidence request exists. Dropping C0003 is better supported than Accept, Split, or Merge.

C0004 shows no significant biological enrichment across RNA, WXS, or CNV, with all q-values high and no coherent molecular program. The structural evidence shows weak cohesion across modalities, and no positive support for Split or Merge. The absence of a defensible biological identity, combined with lack of any resolvable evidence request, makes Drop better supported than Accept.

C0005 has a coherent biological identity defined by strong RNA interferon/inflammatory pathway upregulation and significant BAP1 mutation enrichment (FDR-corrected, large effect size). Although there is a strong per-set tissue source site association (CJ), the biological signal is molecular and coherent, and the site association does not plausibly dominate the RNA and mutation evidence. Structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0005 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
